SS: both sources from shared anchors, seen in both roles in both panels; four new shared queries
UU: both sources from reserved U, excluded from all active training roles/query in both panels
query_holdout: validation query sites excluded as training queries
hop_matching: paired SS and UU at same query have exactly equal ordered hop tuple
uniform: four fixed shared anchors plus eight uniformly sampled eligible extras without replacement; not twelve IID draws
balanced_objective: sum over source,role of exposure_count_in_triples squared
sum over source of role0_count minus role1_count squared
sum over frozen geometric signature bins of triple_count squared
balanced_tie_priority: one permutation of entire ordered candidate pool from namespace9944; fixed for all greedy steps
triplet_order: four shared anchors retain base0,swap0,base1,swap1 prefix; extras sorted lexicographically in both panels
deadline: global from execute command entry, including verification, data preparation and all final measurements
auxiliary_old_panel: all four old validation triples, final b0 measure, outside gate and H-R updates; known not blind; expose new training support
auxiliary_deadline: AUX_NOT_MEASURED if budget prevents it; no extension, model selection or optimizer feedback
gate: per panel both seeds COMPLETE, finite and train/SS/UU>=0.98 final; BALANCED primary fixed before results
incomplete_runs: preserve partial states and NOT_RUN; no retries, extra runs or extensions
